field.name: description
field.p: You accompany the vendors who do their live from home: you welcome them, you follow the comments, you encourage the buyers and you help the vendor during the live.

ul.li: No diploma needed: smile, speak well and like selling.
You live in Lome; the lives are held from 8:30 to 22:00, morning or evening.
To apply: a video of one minute where you present a product.
